req.title: Retrieve player by squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players/squadNumber/{squadNumber} with the player wearing that squad number.

doc.reasoning: The endpoint GET /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} retrieves a player by their squad number. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — a mid-range squad number that exists (squad 10, Messi) verifying exact payload fields; (2) NEG — a squad number that does not exist returns exactly HTTP 404; (3) BVA boundary-low — squad number 1 (lowest in fixture) returns correct player; (4) BVA boundary-high — squad number 26 (highest in fixture) returns correct player; (5) BVA boundary-beyond — squad number 27 (one above highest) returns exactly 404; (6) NEG — non-integer path segment returns 422; (7) EP — squad number 0 (below all valid entries) returns 404; (8) DT — verifies all required response fields are present and correctly typed for a known player. These tests are designed to kill mutations on status-code constants, comparison operators in the not-found branch, and field-mapping logic.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_squad_number_existing_mid_range
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
Squad number 10 corresponds to Lionel Andrés Messi
expected: Response body contains exact player data for Messi
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_squad_number_existing_mid_range():
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Lionel'
    assert body['middleName'] == 'Andrés'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Messi'
    assert body['dateOfBirth'] == '1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z'
    assert body['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert body['abbrPosition'] == 'RW'
    assert body['team'] == 'Paris Saint-Germain'
    assert body['league'] == 'Ligue 1'
    assert body['starting11'] == True
    assert 'id' in body

tests.name: test_get_player_by_squad_number_response_schema_all_fields
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
Squad number 23 corresponds to Damián Emiliano Martínez with all fields populated
actions: Inspect all fields of the response body
expected: All PlayerResponseModel fields present with correct types and exact values
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import uuid
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_squad_number_response_schema_all_fields():
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/23')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body['id'], str)
    uuid.UUID(body['id'])  # must be valid UUID, raises ValueError if not
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Damián'
    assert body['middleName'] == 'Emiliano'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Martínez'
    assert body['dateOfBirth'] == '1992-09-02T00:00:00.000Z'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 23
    assert body['position'] == 'Goalkeeper'
    assert body['abbrPosition'] == 'GK'
    assert body['team'] == 'Aston Villa FC'
    assert body['league'] == 'Premier League'
    assert body['starting11'] == True
